policy: Release is blocked by any open P0 or P1 issue. P2 issues require owner, target month, and accepted-risk notes.

issues.title: Invite-only beta still needs broader representative trip coverage beyond current automated fixtures
issues.acceptedRisk: Current release-candidate gates prove the launch fixture matrix, regional generated actuals, Athens public share, multi-itinerary public-share flows, production health, guest accessibility, and production visual review. The prompt contract enforces 60 representative fixtures across friend groups, couples, families, solo travelers, budget, premium, food, nightlife, outdoors, culture, and six regions. issues.title: Production visual-diff review cadence should mature from artifact capture to routine human review
issues.acceptedRisk: Automated visual gates currently fail on overflow, app errors, clipped text, overlap, and selected pixel diffs before any production visual review can count. Launch signoff requires the production visual review register to track the live production commit and deployment URL, verify reviewed screenshots exist for every production visual result, confirm required public routes and stable diff routes, and record owner, cadence, protocol, verdict, and blocking findings. qa/production-visual-review-progress-2026-06-05.json proves the current live 39780e6 production visual artifact qa/visual-baseline-production-release-2026-06-05-39780e6 and summary qa/visual-baseline-production-release-2026-06-05-39780e6/summary.json are complete, evidence-backed, deployment-bound to globe-travel-gtd34hpiv-rodney-blairs-projects.vercel.app, and not inflating history outside dated review entries. qa/public-launch-status-2026-06-05.json exposes this remaining public-launch blocker as 3/4 distinct visual-review history dates with 1 remaining. qa/production-visual-review-dispatch-outbox-2026-06-05.json, qa/production-visual-review-dispatch-log-2026-06-05.json, and qa/launch-operator-today-2026-06-05.json now carry 1 production visual-review send-packet row for PROD-VISUAL-HISTORY-004 due 2026-06-11. qa/dispatch-sent-record-template-2026-06-05.json, qa/dispatch-sent-record-template-2026-06-05.md, and qa/dispatch-sent-record-template-2026-06-05.csv are the current sent-record starters;
